record.title: HISTOPATHOLOGIAL ALTERATIONS IN BABESIA GIBSONI INFECTIONA CASE REPORT
record.journal: DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals)
record.abstract: An eight-year-old male Labrador with high fever was brought for treatment in the Veterinary Clinical Complex, Faculty of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, WBUAFS, Kolkata. Babesia gibsoni was identified in microscopical examination of the blood smear taken from the animal. The dog could not survive despite treatment and the post mortem examination revealed remarkable changes in the liver, lungs, kidneys and spleen. Histopathological examination showed congestion and edema in lungs, liver and spleen along with remarkable necrotic and degenerative changes in the tubular epithelial cell of kidneys.

screening.rationale: Fatal case with necropsy histopathology: pulmonary oedema, hepatic and splenic congestion, renal tubular necrosis; multisystem pathology.
